comment: The maturity assessment measures capabilities and coverage but not the authority behind them. Two countries with identical component coverage have entirely different prospects if one can oblige participation and the other cannot, yet they would score the same.

public.text: The maturity assessment measures capabilities and coverage but not the authority behind them. Two countries with identical component coverage have entirely different prospects if one can oblige participation and the other cannot, yet they would score the same.
public.suggestedRevision: Add an ordering-readiness dimension, scored separately from technical maturity: duty to connect; right to connect; enforceable norms with proportionate sanctions; statutory tariff or recurrent budget basis; accessible dispute resolution; designated holder per shared function. Countries can then see whether their gap is technical, institutional, or both, which determines what kind of intervention will help.
